mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, device_token, platform, app_version, last_seen_at, status, created_at FROM user_device WHERE device_token = #{token} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, device_token, platform, app_version, last_seen_at, status, created_at FROM user_device WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT id, user_id, device_token, platform, app_version, last_seen_at, status, created_at FROM user_device WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_device (user_id, device_token, platform, app_version, last_seen_at, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deviceToken}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, NOW(), 'active', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_device SET status = 'revoked' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active'
UPDATE user_device SET user_id = #{userId}, platform = #{platform}, app_version = #{appVersion}, last_seen_at = NOW(), status = 'active' WHERE device_token = #{token}
